verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents user-defined rules that automate triage by assigning errors automatically as they arrive (automatic error assignment). Its integrations act on error activity automatically: PagerDuty incident creation, webhook data forwarding as events are processed, and dashboard discard rules synced to SDKs. Missing for 10: detail on rule conditions and the range of actions beyond assignment, a general-purpose rule/workflow engine, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
